name: 🍕 Pizza Delivery [2 Player Obby]
desc:
🍕 Team up with your friend on an adventurous pizza delivery job. Your clients are waiting for you to deliver them their delicious pizza.

⭐Become the best pizza delivery team ever!
👥Pair up with a friend or player to start
💥Avoid the dangerous obstacles to deliver your pizzas safely!

Try your best to reach the end!

Don't forget, teamwork is key!
